UPPER FACE. [8] [Astac.]
Face glowing and red with fever.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Astac.]
Canker spots ; scorbutus.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Astac.]
Swelling of cervical glands with children and old people.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Astac.]
Inward chilliness, and sensitiveness to air ; worse from uncovering.
   

FEVER. [40] [Astac.]
Violent fever with headache, glowing red face, inward chilliness and sensitiveness to air.
   

SKIN. [46] [Astac.]
Nettlerash with liver complaint.
